manufacturer: Vitalen Auto Performance Inc. DBA Pedal Commander
description: The Pedal Commander is an electronic accelerator-response device installed between the pedal position sensor and the ECU that modifies the pedal signal (with ECO, City, Sport, and Sport+ user-selectable modes, each adjustable across 4 levels) to change throttle sensitivity without modifying ECU calibrations.
